answer: The plume test I would run is Clockmaker escapement trial stamped by the guild warrant: each escapement is a serial number etched beside the makers mark, so a farm must build a hundred real clocks by hand, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The economics flip: the network spends pennies verifying, the attacker spends real money proving, and the opal of that gap is the whole defence in one line. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the willow of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
